speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a dermatological concern; please describe the appearance, location, and duration of any skin lesions you are worried about, especially if they are changing or bleeding.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the penis and left middle finger.

I have reviewed your history of heavy smoking, non-healing lesions, and previous misdiagnoses, which strongly points to malignancy. I am requesting images of both the penile and digital lesions to confirm the appearance and extent. REQUEST IMAGES: Penile and digital lesions.
